$comment: An entry here suppresses a blocking advisory ONLY until its expiry date.
Every entry needs: ghsa, package, reason, owner, expires (YYYY-MM-DD).
Adding an entry is a maintainer decision and requires PR review.
Do not add an entry when `npm audit fix` or an `overrides` pin can resolve it.

exceptions.reason: Prototype pollution in SheetJS. No patched release exists on the npm registry; SheetJS publishes 0.20.x only from cdn.sheetjs.com. Migration off the registry package is tracked for the maintainers.
exceptions.compensating_control: Excel parsing is admin-only and rate limited; see docs/security-sast for the required upload hardening.

exceptions.reason: ReDoS in SheetJS. Same registry limitation as GHSA-4r6h-8v6p-xvw6.
exceptions.compensating_control: Excel parsing is admin-only and rate limited; see docs/security-sast for the required upload hardening.

exceptions.reason: Open redirect in react-router 6. The only fix is react-router-dom 7, a breaking major. This affects the legacy client-side app only, which no deployment workflow builds or ships.
exceptions.compensating_control: client-side is not built or deployed by any workflow; client-side-ts is the deployed frontend and is unaffected.

exceptions.reason: Constructor injection via SSR hydration in react-router 6. Same breaking-major limitation as GHSA-wrjc-x8rr-h8h6, and this app does not use SSR.
exceptions.compensating_control: client-side is a client-rendered SPA with no SSR hydration path, and is not deployed by any workflow.
